examples.trans: Dad, did you bring any gum?
Everyone thinks you're in the hospital.
He was admitted to the hospital.

examples.text: Все думают, ты в больнице. Откуда деньги?

говорить.gloss: to speak, to say, to talk

meanings.note: Я тебе говорю = I'm telling you.

meanings.en: голову оторвать = to tear someone's head off
meanings.note: an idiom for a big telling-off

examples.trans: Mum will tear my head off.

examples.text: Какая тебе опергруппа? Мне твоя мать голову оторвёт.
examples.trans: What field team? Your mother will tear my head off.

meanings.note: 'два' with masculine/neuter nouns, 'две' with feminine; the noun goes into the genitive singular

examples.text: Я выйду отсюда через две недели. Я решу все ваши проблемы.
examples.trans: I'll be out of here in two weeks. I'll solve all your problems.

meanings.note: Много дел = a lot to do.

examples.trans: I have a lot to do.

examples.text: Мне некогда об этом думать. Слишком много дел.
examples.trans: I have no time to think about that. There's too much to do.

related.gloss: to reach, walk as far as

meanings.note: думать о + prepositional = to think about

examples.trans: I have no time to think about that.

examples.text: Мне некогда об этом думать. Слишком много дел.
examples.trans: I have no time to think about that. There's too much to do.
The doctor forbade him to drink.

examples.text: Аникеев же запретил! Нам нельзя пить.
examples.trans: But Anikeev forbade it! We mustn't drink.

meanings.note: emphasis: вот поэтому ты и... = that's exactly why you...

examples.trans: I was born and grew up here.

examples.text: Спасибо, спасибо! Как вы все знаете, я родился и вырос в Синеозерске.
examples.trans: Thank you, thank you! As you all know, I was born and grew up in Sineozersk.
Sorry, I didn't mean to offend you.

examples.text: Аркадий Борисович, извините, тут к вам человек.
examples.trans: Arkady Borisovich, excuse me, there's someone here to see you.
Even I feel a bit ashamed right now.
It became somehow quiet in the room.
For long? You need to convince me somehow!

meanings.note: голова кружится = one's head is spinning, one feels dizzy

examples.trans: The leaves are whirling in the wind.

examples.text: Алло, Люся, привет! У Лёвы голова кружится?
examples.trans: Hello, Lyusya, hi! Is Lyova's head spinning?

examples.text: С тех пор я не курю.

examples.trans: Drop the cigarette! Smoking is very harmful!
The cook skillfully prepared tender partridge.

examples.text: Куропатка оставалась, а выбрасывать было жалко.
examples.trans: Partridge was left over, and it was a shame to throw it out.

examples.text: Нет, Федя сам жарил эту куропатку!
examples.trans: No, Fedya roasted that partridge himself!
The fish is at least three days old.

examples.text: Значит, этой рыбе минимум три дня.
examples.trans: That means this fish is at least three days old.

meanings.note: praise, said to a man, woman or child

examples.trans: I see, I see, you're a hero. Well done.

meanings.en: must, need to, it is necessary

examples.trans: We need to do even more.

meanings.note: goes right before the word it negates
+ genitive: 'у нас нет выбора' = we have no choice
hesitation, at the start of a sentence

examples.text: Ну что, очкарик? Видишь, ничего не осталось.
examples.trans: Well, four-eyes? See, there's nothing left.

meanings.note: по порядку = in order; всё в порядке = everything is fine

examples.trans: Now let's go through everything in order.

examples.text: Да, я наведу здесь железный порядок.
examples.trans: Yes, I'll establish iron order here.

examples.text: Мы просто не хотели вас беспокоить. Всё отменим!
examples.trans: We just didn't want to bother you. We'll cancel it all!

examples.trans: Dad, did you bring any gum?

examples.text: Леночка, дорогая, жди меня сегодня к четырём.
examples.trans: Lenochka, darling, expect me today by four.

examples.text: Привет! Смотри, что у меня есть.

meanings.note: pointing at a thing or a situation; 'это' + noun = 'this is ...'
points at something: это моё = that's mine

meanings.en: other forms: этого, этому, это, этим, этом

examples.trans: And this is for you. A toy car!

meanings.en: other forms: меня (gen/acc), мне (dat), мной (instr), мне (prep)
